text.tspan: C23 baseline and lossless private header/memory organization; unchanged public namespaces and generated semantics
VM-owned execution, root-participant and collector-work storage with complete real accessor/caller migration under the existing synchronous adapter
Closed root census, unique copy/scan authority, physical worker/context capacity and one restoration outcome for the admitted synchronous round
Membership/resize/exit ownership and explicit per-VM retirement to global reclamation; known success versus retained failure or unknown result
Foreign roots/borrows, blocking participation, nested callbacks, exception/continuation exits and owner-affine release as a complete service replacement
Generational allocation, promotion and remembered edges including continuation/denv/FFI writers; independent worker service only after its lifecycle prerequisites
Compose accepted cuts against the twelve SMP dimensions, current Gerbil integration and declared progress/scalability workloads

g.text: The current 149-path private candidate mixes several delivery steps and is not automatically one REV. Next action is a read-only hunk/dependency partition, then a fixed first submission tree. Never remove an applicable failed regression or defer the safety of code still included in that tree. Later programme obligations are routed, not converted into pass observations. No new runtime changes are authorized merely by discovering another baseline SMP failure.
